$description: Fūjin design tokens (DTCG 2025.10). Japanese primitives, roles as aliases.

usuzumi.$description: Diluted ink. Upcoming dates, sheet handle, disabled text.

kinari.$description: Unbleached cloth. Card borders, hairlines, progress tracks.

fujin.$description: Fūjin green. Accent, links, goal reached.

matcha.$description: Light green background: goal reached, the "in Ekklo" status.

kin.$description: Gold. Hairlines, dividers. Never used for text.

kin-dark.$description: Readable gold: the only gold allowed for text.

mfp.$description: MyFitnessPal source colour: dots and progress.

mfp-medium.$description: Uncertain remainder of a minimum goal (fibre ≥).

fujin-pale.$description: Pale Fūjin green: share already logged in a progress bar.

mfp-pale.$description: Pale MyFitnessPal blue: share already logged in a progress bar.

seigaiha.$description: Wave lines of the seigaiha pattern on washi.

shu-pale.$description: Pale vermilion: share already logged in a progress bar.

state-card.$description: Storm state card of the Journal (offline, session expired, service down).

field.$description: Input fields. Search fields stay pill-shaped.

hint.$description: Swipe hint bubble under the Journal week band.

tile.$description: Icon tiles of the sent summary.

logo.$description: The Fūjin logo on the splash screen.

aim-frame.$description: Aiming frame on the scanner camera.

glass-tint-rim.$description: Rim of a tinted glass button inside a card (Confirmer).

gold-rule.$description: Short gold rule under the splash tagline.

aim-corner.$description: Corners of the aiming frame on the scanner camera.

read-line.$description: Gold reading line across the aiming frame.

spinner-small.$description: Loading spinner inside a button or a row.

field.$description: Height of the serving field and the suggestion rows.

week-band.$description: Height of the Journal week band: weekday label and day ring.

band-fade.$description: Fade over the half days at both ends of the Journal week band.

band-nudge.$description: How far the Journal week band slides towards past weeks when it shows its swipe hint.

hint-icon.$description: Arrow in the swipe hint bubble under the Journal week band.

hint-padding-vertical.$description: Top and bottom padding of the swipe hint bubble.

hint-padding-end.$description: Padding after the text of the swipe hint bubble.

hint-pointer-width.$description: Width of the triangle on top of the swipe hint bubble.

hint-pointer-height.$description: Height of the triangle on top of the swipe hint bubble.

hint-pointer-inset.$description: Distance from the start of the swipe hint bubble to its triangle.

macro-ring-dash.$description: Dash of the circle around a nutrient without a goal.

macro-ring-dash-gap.$description: Gap between the dashes of the circle around a nutrient without a goal.

skeleton-line.$description: Height of a text line placeholder while the Journal loads.

skeleton-macro.$description: Height of a nutrient label placeholder while the Journal loads.

skeleton-title.$description: Height of a meal name placeholder while the Journal loads.

skeleton-pill.$description: Height of a status pill placeholder while the Journal loads.

skeleton-wide.$description: Width of the long summary line placeholder.

skeleton-medium.$description: Width of the short summary line placeholder.

skeleton-macro-width.$description: Width of a nutrient label placeholder.

skeleton-meal-title.$description: Width of a meal name placeholder.

skeleton-meal-detail.$description: Width of a meal detail placeholder.

skeleton-pill-width.$description: Width of a status pill placeholder.

touch-target.$description: Minimum touch target for every interactive element (48 dp).

tab-bar.$description: Height of the floating tab bar, and side of the round Scanner button.

tab.$description: Height of one tab inside the tab plate.

tab-plate-inset.$description: Padding between the tab plate and its tabs.

row-chevron.$description: Chevron at the end of a list row.

meal-arrow.$description: Arrow between a MyFitnessPal meal and its Ekklo meal.

control-height.$description: Height of a segmented control and of a menu button.

control-note-gap.$description: Gap between a segmented control and the note under it in a card.

switch-width.$description: Width of the track of a switch, as the iOS 26 switch (Figma component "Interrupteur").

switch-height.$description: Height of the track of a switch, as the iOS 26 switch.

switch-thumb-width.$description: Width of the stadium thumb of a switch, 2 inside the track.

switch-thumb-height.$description: Height of the stadium thumb of a switch, 2 inside the track.

switch-lens-width.$description: Width of the glass lens the thumb of a switch becomes while held.

switch-lens-height.$description: Height of the glass lens the thumb of a switch becomes while held, past the track above and below.

search-field.$description: Height of a search field in a page.

weight-field.$description: Width of the weight field of a remembered unit.

pictogram.$description: Round pictogram heading a confirmation sheet.

pictogram-icon.$description: Icon inside the round pictogram of a confirmation sheet.

tab-gap.$description: Gap between two tabs inside the tab plate.

scan-icon.$description: Scan icon in the Scanner button.

appearance-toggle.$description: Side of the glass drop of the day/night toggle, centred in a 48 touch target.

appearance-toggle-icon.$description: Moon or sun icon in the day/night toggle.

aim-frame-width.$description: Width of the aiming frame on the scanner camera.

aim-frame-height.$description: Height of the aiming frame on the scanner camera.

aim-frame-top.$description: Distance from the top safe edge to the aiming frame on the scanner camera.

camera-action-gap.$description: Gap between the Saisir le code button and the bottom safe edge of the scanner camera.

aim-corner.$description: Length of each arm of an aiming frame corner.

glass-blur.$description: Backdrop blur sigma standing in for the Figma glass effect, which has no Flutter equivalent.

floating-shadow-blur.$description: Blur radius of the floating glass drop shadow.

floating-shadow-offset.$description: Vertical offset of the floating glass drop shadow.

floating-shadow-small-blur.$description: Blur radius of the drop shadow of a small glass button (the day/night toggle).

floating-shadow-small-offset.$description: Vertical offset of the drop shadow of a small glass button (the day/night toggle).

scroll-fade.$description: Height of the fade at the bottom of a tab screen, behind the tab bar.

scroll-edge-fade.$description: Where a list scrolls under a fixed header, the length over which the progressive blur and the page wash fade out below the header.

button-compact.$description: Visible height of a compact button, inside a 48 px touch zone.

motif-band.$description: Seigaiha band at the bottom of welcome screens.

motif-band-splash.$description: Seigaiha band at the bottom of the splash screen.

logo.$description: The Fūjin logo on the splash screen.

splash-title-gap.$description: From the splash logo to the app name.

splash-rule-gap.$description: From the splash tagline to the gold rule.

gold-rule-width.$description: Short gold rule under the splash tagline.

glyph-card.$description: Weather glyph of a status card.

glyph-hero.$description: Weather glyph heading a result screen.

text-gap.$description: Gap between a row title and its detail.

highlight.$description: Light gold behind what needs the owner: the Ekklo food to choose (04d) and values that moved in MyFitnessPal (06e).

scrim.$description: Modal scrim under sheets, at 50% opacity.

dark.$description: Background of camera screens and dark pills.

glass.$description: Kinu at 25% over the refracted backdrop: the tab plate and the Scanner button.

glass-ink.$description: Sumi at 80% over the refracted backdrop: the primary button and the chosen filter.

lens-reflection.$description: Reflection along the top and bottom edges inside the glass lens over a held switch, fading towards the middle.

glass-lens.$description: Black at 6%, the tint of the glass lens that swells under the finger on the tab plate.

glass-glow.$description: White at 50%, the light that grows under the finger inside a pressed glass button.

tab-active.$description: Matcha at 80% behind the active tab.

scroll-fade.$description: Washi at 55%, the end of the fade content scrolls into under the tab bar.

pressed.$description: Sumi at 6%, the ink wash under a pressed, hovered or focused surface.

accent.$description: Accent fill: progress, checkbox and switch on, done step, green button, verified dot.

neutral.$description: Neutral fills: neutral chips, switch off, segmented control, clear button, skeletons, offline banner.

floating.$description: Drop shadow of floating glass: the tab plate, the Scanner button and the day/night toggle.

logo.$description: Drop shadow of the Fūjin logo on the splash screen.

alert.$description: Field in error, danger outline button.

control.$description: Unselected radio, sheet handle, dashed empty ring, offline banner outline.

focus.$description: Focused field, selected radio, selected candidate.

warning.$description: Gold outline of an item to review (Ekklo match to choose).

glass-highlight.$description: Lit edge of liquid glass: 1 px inside gradient stroke (top-left and bottom-right) on the tab plate and the glass buttons.

glass-shade.$description: Middle stop of the liquid glass edge gradient (shaded sides).

glass-ink-highlight.$description: Lit edge of ink glass, the primary button colour at 80%: outer stops of its 1 px inside gradient stroke.

glass-ink-shade.$description: Middle stop of the ink glass edge gradient (shaded sides).

lens-edge.$description: Outline of the glass lens over a held switch: 1 px gradient stroke, this colour at the top-left fading to glass-highlight at the bottom-right.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on an accent, source or goal fill.

missed.$description: Arc of a past day that stayed under 98% of its goal. Its length shows the share reached.

missed-background.$description: Background of a past day that stayed under 98% of its goal.

exceeded-logged.$description: Share already logged, goal exceeded (food sheet bars).

in-progress-logged.$description: Share already logged, goal not reached (food sheet bars).

reached-logged.$description: Share already logged, goal reached (food sheet bars).

accent.$description: Viewfinder corners and scan line. Same value in both themes.

background.$description: Camera chrome: round buttons over the camera. Same value in both themes.

button.$description: Button over the camera: washi at 18 % on the camera feed, label role/camera/text. Same value in both themes.

text.$description: Text and icons over the camera. Same value in both themes.

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text over the camera, under the scanner title. Same value in both themes.

hina.$description: Naming: app, dates, states, titles. One weight, 20 px and up.

semibold.$description: kcal and the primary button only.
